title: HSK 3.16 · 整体, 体验, 团结, 演唱会, 判断
focus: 服装 · 判断 · 深刻 · 庆祝 · 体验 · 话题 · 古 · 银 · 羊 · 整理 · 完整 · 谈判 · 飞行 · 深入 · 加强 · 实验室 · 团结 · 谈话 · 天空 · 整天 · 体会 · 团体 · 集体 · 强调 · 加快 · 考验 · 演唱会 · 演唱 · 会员 · 克服 · 体现 · 整体 · 实行 · 整整 · 输入 · 总结 · 空调 · 行李 · 服务员 · 完善
body:
体 *body* and 整 *whole* dominate (体验, 体会, 团体, 集体, 体现, 整体; 整理, 完整, 整天, 整整). Also watch 验 *test*, 谈 *talk*, 行 *go, do* and 演唱 *perform-sing*.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 体 | tǐ | body; whole (亻 + 本 root) | 体验, 体会, 团体, 集体, 体现, 整体 |
| 整 | zhěng | whole; tidy | 整理, 完整, 整天, 整体, 整整 |
| 验 | yàn | test, check (马 horse) | 体验, 实验室, 考验 |
| 谈 | tán | talk (讠 speech + 炎) | 谈判, 谈话 |
| 行 | xíng | go; do | 飞行, 实行, 行李 |
| 服 | fú | clothes; serve; submit | 服装, 克服, 服务员 |
| 会 | huì | meeting; able | 体会, 演唱会, 会员 |
| 结 | jié | tie, knot (纟 thread) | 团结, 总结 |

## Watch out

- 调 is **tiáo** in 空调 (air-con) but **diào** in 强调 (emphasize).
- 行李 is xíngli with neutral li.
- 判 (半 + 刂) vs 叛 pàn (betray): 判 = cut in half to judge.

cards.Example: 这家店卖服装。 zhè jiā diàn mài fúzhuāng: This shop sells clothes
cards.Notes: 服 clothes + 装 outfit (衣 clothing + 壮 zhuàng sound) = clothing

cards.Example: 你判断得对。 nǐ pànduàn de duì: Your judgment is right
cards.Notes: 判 split, judge (半 half + 刂 knife) + 断 break off, decide = cut and decide

cards.Example: 我印象很深刻。 wǒ yìnxiàng hěn shēnkè: It made a deep impression
cards.Notes: 深 deep (氵 water) + 刻 carve (刂 knife) = deeply carved

cards.Example: 我们一起庆祝吧！ wǒmen yìqǐ qìngzhù ba: Let's celebrate together!
cards.Notes: 庆 celebrate (广 + 大) + 祝 wish well (礻 altar + 兄) = celebrate with good wishes

cards.Example: 这是很好的体验。 zhè shì hěn hǎo de tǐyàn: It's a great experience
cards.Notes: 体 body + 验 test = test with your own body, experience

cards.Example: 我们换个话题吧。 wǒmen huàn ge huàtí ba: Let's change the subject
cards.Notes: 话 talk + 题 topic, title (页 head + 是 shì sound) = topic of talk

cards.Example: 这是一座古城。 zhè shì yí zuò gǔchéng: This is an ancient city
cards.Notes: 十 ten + 口 mouth = passed through ten mouths, old (traditional reading). Phonetic in 姑, 故

cards.Example: 我去银行。 wǒ qù yínháng: I'm going to the bank
cards.Notes: 钅 metal + 艮 (gèn, phonetic) = silver; 银行 bank = silver firm

cards.Example: 山上有很多羊。 shān shang yǒu hěn duō yáng: There are many sheep on the hill
cards.Notes: Picture of a sheep's head with horns. Inside 美, 洋, 样

cards.Example: 我在整理房间。 wǒ zài zhěnglǐ fángjiān: I'm tidying my room
cards.Notes: 整 put in order + 理 arrange = put in order

cards.Example: 这本书很完整。 zhè běn shū hěn wánzhěng: This book is intact
cards.Notes: 完 finished, whole + 整 whole = all complete

cards.Example: 两个公司在谈判。 liǎng ge gōngsī zài tánpàn: The two firms are negotiating
cards.Notes: 谈 talk + 判 judge, decide = talk to a decision

cards.Example: 飞行时间很长。 fēixíng shíjiān hěn cháng: The flight is long
cards.Notes: 飞 fly + 行 travel = travel by air

cards.Example: 我们深入谈谈。 wǒmen shēnrù tántan: Let's talk in depth
cards.Notes: 深 deep + 入 enter = enter deeply. Lookalike: 入 rù vs 人 rén

cards.Example: 我要加强练习。 wǒ yào jiāqiáng liànxí: I need to practise more
cards.Notes: 加 add + 强 strong = add strength

cards.Example: 他在实验室工作。 tā zài shíyànshì gōngzuò: He works in a lab
cards.Notes: 实 real + 验 test + 室 room = room for real tests, lab

cards.Example: 我们要团结。 wǒmen yào tuánjié: We must stick together
cards.Notes: 团 group + 结 tie = tie into one group

cards.Example: 老师找我谈话。 lǎoshī zhǎo wǒ tánhuà: The teacher wants a word with me
cards.Notes: 谈 talk + 话 speech = talk

cards.Example: 天空很蓝。 tiānkōng hěn lán: The sky is blue
cards.Notes: 天 sky + 空 empty space = the open sky

cards.Example: 他整天玩游戏。 tā zhěngtiān wán yóuxì: He plays games all day
cards.Notes: 整 whole + 天 day = the whole day

cards.Example: 我能体会你的感受。 wǒ néng tǐhuì nǐ de gǎnshòu: I understand how you feel
cards.Notes: 体 body + 会 understand = understand through experience

cards.Example: 我们是一个团体。 wǒmen shì yí ge tuántǐ: We're one group
cards.Notes: 团 group + 体 body = group body, organization

cards.Example: 这是集体的决定。 zhè shì jítǐ de juédìng: It's a group decision
cards.Notes: 集 gather + 体 body = gathered body, collective

cards.Example: 老师强调了这一点。 lǎoshī qiángdiào le zhè yì diǎn: The teacher stressed this
cards.Notes: 强 strong + 调 tone (diào) = say in a strong tone

cards.Example: 我们加快速度吧。 wǒmen jiākuài sùdù ba: Let's speed up
cards.Notes: 加 add + 快 fast = add speed

cards.Example: 这是一个考验。 zhè shì yí ge kǎoyàn: This is a test
cards.Notes: 考 examine + 验 check = trial, test (of character)

cards.Example: 我们去看演唱会吧。 wǒmen qù kàn yǎnchànghuì ba: Let's go to a concert
cards.Notes: 演 perform + 唱 sing + 会 gathering = singing-performance event

cards.Example: 她在台上演唱。 tā zài tái shang yǎnchàng: She's singing on stage
cards.Notes: 演 perform (氵 + 寅 yín) + 唱 sing (口 + 昌 chāng sound) = perform by singing

cards.Example: 你是会员吗？ nǐ shì huìyuán ma: Are you a member?
cards.Notes: 会 association + 员 member = association member

cards.Example: 我们会克服困难。 wǒmen huì kèfú kùnnan: We'll overcome the difficulty
cards.Notes: 克 subdue + 服 submit = make it submit, overcome

cards.Example: 这体现了他的爱。 zhè tǐxiàn le tā de ài: This shows his love
cards.Notes: 体 body + 现 appear = give body to, embody

cards.Example: 整体来说不错。 zhěngtǐ lái shuō búcuò: Overall it's not bad
cards.Notes: 整 whole + 体 body = whole body, overall

cards.Example: 新规定开始实行。 xīn guīdìng kāishǐ shíxíng: The new rule is in effect
cards.Notes: 实 real + 行 do = put into real practice

cards.Example: 我等了整整两个小时。 wǒ děng le zhěngzhěng liǎng ge xiǎoshí: I waited two full hours
cards.Notes: 整 whole, doubled for emphasis = a whole, full

cards.Example: 请输入密码。 qǐng shūrù mìmǎ: Please enter the password
cards.Notes: 输 transport + 入 enter = send in, input. Lookalike: 入 vs 人

cards.Example: 我来总结一下。 wǒ lái zǒngjié yíxià: Let me sum up
cards.Notes: 总 all, total + 结 tie up = tie everything together

cards.Example: 把空调打开。 bǎ kōngtiáo dǎkāi: Turn on the air-con
cards.Notes: 空 air + 调 adjust (tiáo) = air adjuster

cards.Example: 你的行李多吗？ nǐ de xíngli duō ma: Do you have much luggage?
cards.Notes: 行 travel + 李 plum (borrowed; adds no meaning here) = travel things, luggage

cards.Example: 服务员，买单！ fúwùyuán, mǎidān: Waiter, the bill!
cards.Notes: 服 serve + 务 task + 员 person = person who serves

cards.Example: 这个计划还要完善。 zhège jìhuà hái yào wánshàn: The plan needs refining
cards.Notes: 完 complete + 善 good = complete and good, perfect
